state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Christmas in 5 sentences. Christmas is the holiday everyone celebrates at the end of the year, and it's all about presents. These tweets obviously prove it. Just tell me what normal people think about Christmas; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Some users express gratitude for receiving extra presents or better gifts than they asked for during Christmas. Several tweets describe negative experiences, such as gaining weight from food, being kicked out of a dorm, or dealing with work schedules that prevented opening gifts on time. A number of people mention taking down their Christmas trees and decorations to mark the end of the holiday season. Others share personal stories about missing friends, spending money on gifts, or reacting to specific items like new boots and coffee makers received as presents. Some users make jokes about wanting specific things for Christmas while others express disappointment with the holiday or the lack of snow.
